title: The Lands and Their Borders
summary: The king sends a proclamation throughout his land. The account describes Lamanite and Nephite territories, the wilderness and seashores, Bountiful and Desolation, and the small neck of land. Nephites inhabit Bountiful and use guards and armies to hem in the Lamanites on the south.

explicit_facts.text: The king sends a proclamation throughout his land; a strip of wilderness divides it from Zarahemla.
Some Lamanites dwell in tents in western wilderness and seashore areas.
Many Lamanites are by the eastern seashore, where Nephites had driven them; Nephites hold northern lands extending toward Bountiful.
Bountiful borders Desolation, which extends into a land previously peopled and destroyed.
Desolation is north of Bountiful; the wilderness is filled with wild animals, some of which came from the north for food.
The Bountiful–Desolation line is a day and a half’s journey for a Nephite from the east to the west sea; a small neck connects the northern and southern lands.
Nephites inhabit Bountiful from the east to the west sea and, with guards and armies, hem in the Lamanites on the south.
The Lamanites’ possessions are limited to Nephi and the surrounding wilderness; the Nephites seek to keep a country to which they may flee.
